title: name 某/某某 (placeholder for a name)
longExplanation: placeholder for a name. Pinyin: name mǒu/ mǒumǒu

examples.sentence: 公司业务员李某/李某某闻之大喜。
examples.romanization: gōngsī yèwùyuán lǐ mǒu/ lǐ mǒumǒu wén zhī dàxǐ。
examples.translation: Company salesman Li (So-and-so) heard the big joy.

examples.sentence: 他运动时受伤了，行动不便。
examples.romanization: tā yùndòng shí shòushāng le， xíngdòngbùbiàn。
examples.translation: When he was doing sports he injured his feet, so it’s hard for him to move around.

examples.sentence: 有些鸟类喜欢单独行动。
examples.translation: Some birds like to act alone.

examples.sentence: 建设家乡，人人有责，我们也要承担这个义务。
examples.romanization: jiànshè jiāxiāng， rénrényǒuzé， wǒmen yě yào chéngdān zhège yìwù。
examples.translation: Everyone has the responsibility of building his/her hometown, and we should also take up this obligation.

examples.sentence: 我们每个学期都要至少参加三次义务劳动。
examples.romanization: wǒmen měi gè xuéqī dōu yào zhìshǎo cānjiā sāncì yìwù láodòng。
examples.translation: We must participate in at least three compulsory labor per semester.

examples.sentence: 我们学校的正门坐西朝东。
examples.romanization: wǒmen xuéxiào de zhèngmén zuò xī cháo dōng。
examples.translation: The main entrance of our school is situated in the west and oriented toward the east.

examples.sentence: 他几乎每天都能钓到5斤来重的大鱼。
examples.romanization: tā jīhū měitiān dōu néng diào dào5 jīn lái zhòng de dà yú。
examples.translation: He can catch over 5 pounds (weight) of fish almost every day.

title: 一来(是)……二来(是)…… (First… secondly…)
longExplanation: First… secondly…. Pinyin: yīlái( shì)…… èrlái( shì)……

examples.sentence: 我到这里看看大家，一(来)是给大家送水果，二(来)是看看大家过节还有什么难处。
examples.romanization: wǒ dào zhèlǐ kànkan dàjiā， yī( lái) shì gěi dàjiā sòng shuǐguǒ， èr( lái) shì kànkan dàjiā guòjié háiyǒu shénme nánchu。
examples.translation: I am here to see everyone, one [reason] is to bring fruit to everyone, another [reason] is to see if anyone has any difficulties over the holidays.

examples.sentence: 我们决定明年结婚，至于具体时间还要再商量。
examples.romanization: wǒmen juédìng míngnián jiéhūn， zhìyú jùtǐ shíjiān hái yào zài shāngliang。
examples.translation: We decided to get married next year. As for the specific time, we’ll have to discuss later.

title: 至于 (go so far as)
longExplanation: go so far as. Pinyin: zhìyú

examples.translation: He won’t go so far as to tell a lie.

examples.sentence: 经过沟通，大导演总算搞明白了。
examples.romanization: jīngguò gōutōng， dà dǎoyǎn zǒngsuàn gǎo míngbai le。
examples.translation: After communicating, the principal director has finally figured it out.
